name: Podcast
description: Summarize a recorded podcast episode, whether it is a guest conversation or a solo show.

sections.title: Episode Overview
sections.instruction: Summarize what the episode is about and its central point in natural language. Do not assume there is a guest, host, audience, or episode title unless the recording establishes it.

sections.title: Key Themes
sections.instruction: List the main subjects and insights covered, preserving meaningful differences between speakers when attribution is clear.

sections.title: Stories & Examples
sections.instruction: Capture memorable stories, experiences, examples, and supporting details from the episode. Do not invent quotes or facts that were not said.

sections.title: Takeaways
sections.instruction: Summarize the ideas or lessons a listener could reasonably take from what was discussed. Keep interpretation close to the recorded content rather than adding new advice.

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.instruction: Include only explicit follow-up actions, promised resources, or corrections mentioned during the recording. Omit this section when none were stated.
